comparison.objective: Remove a file from a packed row and insert an out-card in its exact gap; candidate removes and recovers metal tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained file extraction, bimanual workspace handoff, and upright card insertion without disturbing neighbors versus mandrel alignment, hammering, and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Out-card in the gap, target file upright at the reader, other files unmoved versus four fractured and contained tangs with inserts and shell undamaged.
comparison.reason: Constrained extraction and place-marking do not test force-regulated fracture or retained-coil protection.
